technical_get_full_technical_analysis.name: technical_get_full_technical_analysis
technical_get_full_technical_analysis.title: Technical Get Full Technical Analysis
technical_get_full_technical_analysis.description:
Full technical analysis for `ticker`: trend, outlook, and every indicator.

Levels use the requested calendar `days`, or 30 trailing bars by default.
Indicators fetch additional history for warm-up.

portfolio_get_risk_dashboard.name: portfolio_get_risk_dashboard
portfolio_get_risk_dashboard.title: Portfolio Get Risk Dashboard
portfolio_get_risk_dashboard.description:
Full risk dashboard for `portfolio_name`: total value, sector
concentration, parametric VaR (95/99), and total unrealized P&L.

research_analyze_company.name: research_analyze_company
research_analyze_company.title: Research Analyze Company
research_analyze_company.description: Run comprehensive research on a specific company.

market_data_clear_market_cache.name: market_data_clear_market_cache
market_data_clear_market_cache.title: Market Data Clear Market Cache
market_data_clear_market_cache.description:
Clear the cached quote for `ticker`, or every quote plus the market
overview cache when `ticker` is omitted.

screening_get_all.name: screening_get_all
screening_get_all.title: Screening Get All
screening_get_all.description: Latest snapshot across all three screens (each independently dated).

screening_get_supply_demand.name: screening_get_supply_demand
screening_get_supply_demand.title: Screening Get Supply Demand
screening_get_supply_demand.description: Top supply/demand breakout screen results, newest snapshot only.

portfolio_journal_review.name: portfolio_journal_review
portfolio_journal_review.title: Portfolio Journal Review
portfolio_journal_review.description:
Full detail for a single trade by ID, including the side-aware
`pnl_pct` (only populated once the trade is closed).

portfolio_remove_position.name: portfolio_remove_position
portfolio_remove_position.title: Portfolio Remove Position
portfolio_remove_position.description: Remove `shares` from `ticker` (or the entire position when omitted).

research_run_comprehensive.name: research_run_comprehensive
research_run_comprehensive.title: Research Run Comprehensive
research_run_comprehensive.description: Run comprehensive web-search-backed research on a financial topic.

technical_get_macd_analysis.name: technical_get_macd_analysis
technical_get_macd_analysis.title: Technical Get Macd Analysis
technical_get_macd_analysis.description:
MACD reading, signal label, and crossover state for `ticker`.

Any period left `None` falls back to its `TechnicalSettings` default.

technical_get_rsi_analysis.name: technical_get_rsi_analysis
technical_get_rsi_analysis.title: Technical Get Rsi Analysis
technical_get_rsi_analysis.description:
RSI reading and signal label for `ticker`.

`period`/`days` left `None` fall back to `TechnicalSettings` defaults.

backtesting_optimize_strategy.name: backtesting_optimize_strategy
backtesting_optimize_strategy.title: Backtesting Optimize Strategy
backtesting_optimize_strategy.description: Grid-search a strategy's parameters (sma_cross, rsi, macd, bollinger, or momentum only).

market_data_get_market_overview.name: market_data_get_market_overview
market_data_get_market_overview.title: Market Data Get Market Overview
market_data_get_market_overview.description: Fetch indices, sector performance, top movers, and volatility.

portfolio_add_position.name: portfolio_add_position
portfolio_add_position.title: Portfolio Add Position
portfolio_add_position.description: Add (or average into) a position in `portfolio_name`.

backtesting_run_backtest.name: backtesting_run_backtest
backtesting_run_backtest.title: Backtesting Run Backtest
backtesting_run_backtest.description: Run a single-strategy backtest and return metrics, trades, and analysis.

market_data_get_price_history.name: market_data_get_price_history
market_data_get_price_history.title: Market Data Get Price History
market_data_get_price_history.description: Fetch OHLCV price history for `ticker`, smart-cached via the service.

technical_get_support_resistance.name: technical_get_support_resistance
technical_get_support_resistance.title: Technical Get Support Resistance
technical_get_support_resistance.description:
Observed low/high range for `ticker`, a support/resistance heuristic.

`days` selects calendar history; `None` uses `sr_lookback` bars (default 30).
Returns the method and number of bars used, without synthetic price levels.

portfolio_watchlist_remove.name: portfolio_watchlist_remove
portfolio_watchlist_remove.title: Portfolio Watchlist Remove
portfolio_watchlist_remove.description: Remove a ticker symbol from a watchlist.

market_data_get_stock_fundamentals.name: market_data_get_stock_fundamentals
market_data_get_stock_fundamentals.title: Market Data Get Stock Fundamentals
market_data_get_stock_fundamentals.description: Fetch company fundamentals: valuation, financials, and trading stats.

portfolio_compare_tickers.name: portfolio_compare_tickers
portfolio_compare_tickers.title: Portfolio Compare Tickers
portfolio_compare_tickers.description:
Side-by-side comparison of `tickers`, or of `portfolio_name`'s
holdings when `tickers` is omitted (requires >= 2 holdings).

portfolio_get_risk_alerts.name: portfolio_get_risk_alerts
portfolio_get_risk_alerts.title: Portfolio Get Risk Alerts
portfolio_get_risk_alerts.description:
Current risk alerts for `portfolio_name`: sector concentration,
oversized positions, and portfolio drawdown threshold breaches.

backtesting_run_ml_strategy_backtest.name: backtesting_run_ml_strategy_backtest
backtesting_run_ml_strategy_backtest.title: Backtesting Run Ml Strategy Backtest
backtesting_run_ml_strategy_backtest.description:
Run a backtest using an ML-enhanced strategy (ml_predictor, adaptive, ensemble, or
regime_aware).

backtesting_train_ml_predictor.name: backtesting_train_ml_predictor
backtesting_train_ml_predictor.title: Backtesting Train Ml Predictor
backtesting_train_ml_predictor.description: Train a random-forest ML predictor model for trading signals.

backtesting_analyze_market_regimes.name: backtesting_analyze_market_regimes
backtesting_analyze_market_regimes.title: Backtesting Analyze Market Regimes
backtesting_analyze_market_regimes.description:
Analyze market regimes (bear/sideways/bull) for a symbol using ML methods.

`method="hmm"` (the default) fits an `sklearn.mixture.GaussianMixture`,
not a genuine Hidden Markov Model -- the name is kept for backward
compatibility. `method="kmeans"` is real k-means clustering;
`method="threshold"` is a zero-model rule-based classifier. The returned
`method` field reports what was actually used, which can differ from the
request if there wasn't enough history to fit a statistical model
(silently falls back to "threshold"). Each history entry's
`probabilities` are the fitted model's real posterior when one exists,
otherwise an honest one-hot at the assigned regime -- never a fabricated
uniform distribution.

backtesting_create_strategy_ensemble.name: backtesting_create_strategy_ensemble
backtesting_create_strategy_ensemble.title: Backtesting Create Strategy Ensemble
backtesting_create_strategy_ensemble.description: Create and backtest a weighted ensemble of base strategies across multiple symbols.

portfolio_check_position_risk.name: portfolio_check_position_risk
portfolio_check_position_risk.title: Portfolio Check Position Risk
portfolio_check_position_risk.description:
Pre-trade risk check: current vs. projected portfolio risk if
`shares` of `ticker` were added at `entry_price`.

market_data_get_quote.name: market_data_get_quote
market_data_get_quote.title: Market Data Get Quote
market_data_get_quote.description: Fetch a single quote (TTL-cached by the service).

market_data_get_chart_links.name: market_data_get_chart_links
market_data_get_chart_links.title: Market Data Get Chart Links
market_data_get_chart_links.description: Static external chart links for `ticker` (no service call, no network).

portfolio_journal_close_trade.name: portfolio_journal_close_trade
portfolio_journal_close_trade.title: Portfolio Journal Close Trade
portfolio_journal_close_trade.description:
Close an open trade by entry ID. PnL is computed automatically
(long: exit-entry, short: entry-exit), multiplied by shares, then
rounded to cents with ROUND_HALF_UP. Exit price must be finite and
positive. Strategy performance is recomputed for every trade tag.

portfolio_journal_list_trades.name: portfolio_journal_list_trades
portfolio_journal_list_trades.title: Portfolio Journal List Trades
portfolio_journal_list_trades.description:
List journal trades, optionally filtered by symbol, status
(open/closed), or strategy tag. Newest entry date first.

portfolio_watchlist_add.name: portfolio_watchlist_add
portfolio_watchlist_add.title: Portfolio Watchlist Add
portfolio_watchlist_add.description:
Add a ticker symbol to an existing watchlist. Repeat calls for the
same symbol add another entry rather than replacing it.

screening_get_bearish.name: screening_get_bearish
screening_get_bearish.title: Screening Get Bearish
screening_get_bearish.description: Top bearish screen results, newest snapshot only.

screening_get_bullish.name: screening_get_bullish
screening_get_bullish.title: Screening Get Bullish
screening_get_bullish.description: Top bullish-momentum screen results, newest snapshot only.

backtesting_monte_carlo_simulation.name: backtesting_monte_carlo_simulation
backtesting_monte_carlo_simulation.title: Backtesting Monte Carlo Simulation
backtesting_monte_carlo_simulation.description: Bootstrap-resample a backtest's trades to estimate a return/drawdown distribution.

market_data_get_price_history_batch.name: market_data_get_price_history_batch
market_data_get_price_history_batch.title: Market Data Get Price History Batch
market_data_get_price_history_batch.description:
Fetch OHLCV price history for multiple tickers.

A single bad ticker's failure is captured per-ticker in `results` rather
than aborting the whole batch; a shared bad `start_date`/`end_date`
(parsed once up front), or a `tickers` list exceeding `settings.
history_batch_max`, fails the whole call instead, since neither can be
attributed to any one ticker. The happy path (including one with
per-ticker failures) always carries a top-level `"status": "success"` so
callers can branch on it uniformly before looking at `results`.

backtesting_parse_strategy.name: backtesting_parse_strategy
backtesting_parse_strategy.title: Backtesting Parse Strategy
backtesting_parse_strategy.description:
Parse a natural-language strategy description into a strategy type and parameters,
using the configured BYOK LLM when available and degrading to zero-dependency keyword
parsing otherwise (see `strategies.parser.StrategyParser.parse_with_llm`).

backtesting_list_strategies.name: backtesting_list_strategies
backtesting_list_strategies.title: Backtesting List Strategies
backtesting_list_strategies.description: List every available rule-based strategy template with its default parameters.

portfolio_watchlist_list.name: portfolio_watchlist_list
portfolio_watchlist_list.title: Portfolio Watchlist List
portfolio_watchlist_list.description: List saved watchlist IDs, names, and descriptions in creation order.

backtesting_compare_strategies.name: backtesting_compare_strategies
backtesting_compare_strategies.title: Backtesting Compare Strategies
backtesting_compare_strategies.description: Backtest multiple strategies on the same symbol and rank them.

portfolio_get_regime_adjusted_sizing.name: portfolio_get_regime_adjusted_sizing
portfolio_get_regime_adjusted_sizing.title: Portfolio Get Regime Adjusted Sizing
portfolio_get_regime_adjusted_sizing.description:
Position size scaled by the current SPY-detected market regime
(bull = full risk, choppy/transitional = 75%, bear = 50%).

screening_run_screens.name: screening_run_screens
screening_run_screens.title: Screening Run Screens
screening_run_screens.description:
Recompute one screen (or all three when `screen` is omitted) and persist it.

Always returns a `screen name -> ScreenRun` mapping under `results`, even
for a single explicit screen, so callers never need to branch on shape.
Screens only symbols already known locally; with none, returns an error
that says how to add them.

backtesting_backtest_portfolio.name: backtesting_backtest_portfolio
backtesting_backtest_portfolio.title: Backtesting Backtest Portfolio
backtesting_backtest_portfolio.description:
Backtest one strategy across multiple symbols and aggregate portfolio-level
metrics.

Each symbol is backtested independently (no combined equity curve, no
cross-symbol correlation). `total_return`/`average_sharpe` are per-symbol
averages; `max_drawdown` is the worst (most negative) constituent
drawdown, not a joint-portfolio calculation.

portfolio_get_strategy_performance.name: portfolio_get_strategy_performance
portfolio_get_strategy_performance.title: Portfolio Get Strategy Performance
portfolio_get_strategy_performance.description:
Strategy performance analytics. `compare=False` (default) returns
win/loss/expectancy/profit-factor for a single `strategy_tag`
(required). `compare=True` returns every strategy ranked by expectancy
descending, absorbing legacy's separate `get_strategy_comparison` tool
into this one via the flag -- `strategy_tag` is ignored in that mode.

portfolio_risk_adjusted_analysis.name: portfolio_risk_adjusted_analysis
portfolio_risk_adjusted_analysis.title: Portfolio Risk Adjusted Analysis
portfolio_risk_adjusted_analysis.description:
ATR-based position sizing/stop/target for `ticker`, plus an
existing-position block if `portfolio_name` already holds it.

portfolio_watchlist_brief.name: portfolio_watchlist_brief
portfolio_watchlist_brief.title: Portfolio Watchlist Brief
portfolio_watchlist_brief.description:
Intelligence brief for every symbol on a watchlist: notes, days on
watchlist, and the current price via market_data.

portfolio_get_my_portfolio.name: portfolio_get_my_portfolio
portfolio_get_my_portfolio.title: Portfolio Get My Portfolio
portfolio_get_my_portfolio.description: Full portfolio snapshot: every position plus live-priced metrics.

portfolio_correlation_analysis.name: portfolio_correlation_analysis
portfolio_correlation_analysis.title: Portfolio Correlation Analysis
portfolio_correlation_analysis.description:
Correlation matrix and diversification metrics for `tickers`, or for
`portfolio_name`'s holdings when `tickers` is omitted (requires >= 2
holdings).

portfolio_journal_add_trade.name: portfolio_journal_add_trade
portfolio_journal_add_trade.title: Portfolio Journal Add Trade
portfolio_journal_add_trade.description:
Add an open trade to the journal. `entry_date` is an ISO 8601 date or
datetime (for example `2026-03-15` or `2026-03-15T14:30:00Z`) for a trade
made earlier; omit it to record the trade as entered now. Naive dates
are UTC. Side is long or short (case-insensitive); prices and shares
must be finite and positive. Unit prices retain subcent precision.

backtesting_walk_forward_analysis.name: backtesting_walk_forward_analysis
backtesting_walk_forward_analysis.title: Backtesting Walk Forward Analysis
backtesting_walk_forward_analysis.description: Roll a strategy forward through repeated optimize/test windows to gauge robustness.

portfolio_watchlist_create.name: portfolio_watchlist_create
portfolio_watchlist_create.title: Portfolio Watchlist Create
portfolio_watchlist_create.description:
Create a new named watchlist for tracking ticker symbols. The name
must be unique.

research_analyze_sentiment.name: research_analyze_sentiment
research_analyze_sentiment.title: Research Analyze Sentiment
research_analyze_sentiment.description: Analyze market sentiment for a specific topic or sector.

screening_get_by_criteria.name: screening_get_by_criteria
screening_get_by_criteria.title: Screening Get By Criteria
screening_get_by_criteria.description: Latest bullish screen results filtered by arbitrary criteria (AND-ed).
